'''Sawa Shrine''' (さわじんじゃ) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|Q845945|qid=Q845945}} in Nishina, {{ill|Nishiizu|Q1203949|qid=Q1203949}}, {{ill|Kamo District, Shizuoka|Q961511|qid=Q961511}}, {{ill|Shizuoka Prefecture|Q131320|qid=Q131320}}. It is one of the {{ill|List of Shikinaisha in Izu Province|Q11380552|qid=Q11380552|lt=Shikinaisha of Izu Province}}<ref name="yuisho">Precinct history board</ref>.

=== Overview ===
Its foundation is unknown, but because it is a {{ill|Shikinaisha|lt=Shikinaisha|qid=Q134917286}}, it dates back to before {{ill|Enchō|Q1327274|qid=Q1327274|lt=Enchō}} 5 ({{ill|927|Q30470|qid=Q30470}}), when the ''{{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Q11064932|qid=Q11064932}}'' was compiled<ref>[https://kotobank.jp/word/神名帳-82644 神名帳とは] - {{ill|Kotobank|Q11302260|qid=Q11302260}}</ref>.

The shrine name “Sawa” shares its origin with the place name “Sawa/澤”<ref name="yuisho"/>.

Originally, Mishima Myōjin and Hachimangū stood side by side by the sea (present-day Nishina Port/Kamogaike Site), but due to a tsunami they were moved to the current site in {{ill|Keichō|Q1328185|qid=Q1328185}} 14 ({{ill|1609|Q6762|qid=Q6762}}), and were merged into one shrine in March of {{ill|Bunsei|Q1327119|qid=Q1327119}} 6 ({{ill|1823|Q6988|qid=Q6988}})<ref name="yuisho"/>.

At the annual festival on November 2-3, the “Ningyō {{ill|Sanbasō|Q11356796|qid=Q11356796}},” a prefecturally designated intangible folk cultural property preserved in only five places in the Izu area (three in this town), is performed<ref>[https://www.nishiizu-kankou.com/sightseeing/sawasanbasou 佐波神社三番叟] - Nishiizu Tourism Association</ref><ref>[https://www.pref.shizuoka.jp/kankosports/bunkageijutsu/bunkazai/1002825/1041003/1041888/1004974/1021026.html 仁科の人形三番叟] - Shizuoka Prefecture</ref>. (For reference, the remaining four places are: in town, Ushikoshi Shrine in Ukusu and (Kainano) Shinmei Shrine in central Nishina; outside town, Isuzugawa Shrine in Koura, Minamiizu, and Ogawa Shrine in the Nakaizu area of Izu City<ref>[https://www.nishiizu-kankou.com/sightseeing/ushisanbasou 牛越神社人形三番叟] - Nishiizu Tourism Association</ref><ref>[https://www.pref.shizuoka.jp/kankosports/bunkageijutsu/bunkazai/1002825/1041003/1041888/1004974/1021027.html 海名野神明神社の人形三番叟] - Shizuoka Prefecture</ref><ref>[https://www.pref.shizuoka.jp/kankosports/bunkageijutsu/bunkazai/1002825/1041003/1041888/1004974/1021025.html 人形三番叟] - Shizuoka Prefecture</ref>.)
